paper.textual_conclusion: The findings suggest that LeNet and EffectiveNet show the best results among the considered architectures. LeNet has an accuracy of 0.990, penalty matrix score of 3.017, EffectiveNet has an accuracy of 0.967, penalty matrix score of 3.017. gates.reason: The paper trains on 2,100 images, 50 per class, with a random 80/10/10 split. The supplied archive holds 14,249 images, 142 to 446 per class.
